# Vendored browser assets

Generated by `bash scripts/vendor-web.sh` (laptop, internet, once). npm tarballs are
verified against the pinned `dist.integrity` before extraction; no install script runs.
Nothing is fetched at runtime: the tablet loads everything from the core.
